review.assessment: The application fully satisfies all mandatory requirements with clean, robust implementations of data fetching, reactive responsive images, filtering, sorting, mutation handling, and comprehensive GraphQL testing. Optional features were correctly omitted as allowed.

findings.evidence: src/components/InventoryDashboard.tsx uses useCars to load cars, displays loading states with CircularProgress and error states with Alert, and maps items to CarCard components showing make, model, year, colour, and photo.

src/components/CarCard.tsx uses useMediaQuery with queries '(max-width: 640px)' and '(min-width: 641px) and (max-width: 1023px)' to select mobile, tablet, or desktop image URLs reacting to viewport changes. findings.remediationTitle: Use the exact values the specification states (640, 641, 1023, 1024)

findings.evidence: src/components/InventoryDashboard.tsx filters cars case-insensitively by model using searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim() and displays an Alert with 'No cars match your search.' when nothing matches.
src/components/InventoryDashboard.tsx sorts cars alphabetically by make using localeCompare when 'make' is selected, and newest first using b.year - a.year when 'year' is selected.

src/components/AddCarForm.tsx collects make, model, year, and colour, validates non-empty fields and plausible years, and src/hooks/useCars.ts submits via mutation with refetchQueries updating the list without page reload.
src/hooks/useCars.ts encapsulates useQuery and useMutation in a single custom hook returning cars, loading, error, addCar, and addCarLoading.
src/__tests__/InventoryDashboard.test.tsx covers list rendering, search filtering, sorting reordering, and form submission using MockedProvider from @apollo/client/testing.
